content: For ESP32 sensor nodes pushing to a backend: MQTT (QoS0/1) is the common IoT-native choice for lightweight pub/sub telemetry with reconnect logic, but for an actuator command loop needing per-command ack/idempotency/retry (as this spec requires), HTTP request/response with signed payload is simpler and matches the ack-timeout-retry semantics directly. Payload validation (reject NaN/out-of-range before publish) is a universal best practice.
